name: harness-decide
title: Harness Decide
description: [closed|all] Alone: open decisions. Text: explain it, then decide. Keep the harness decision register: list open decisions apart from optional setup, explain a decision or question with its options, and save the choice, or leave a new question open. Shorthand: /hn-decide. Overlaps with architecture-decision-records on history; owns the compact bulletin and register.
author: wzlwit
examples: /harness-decide Postgres or Redis for the cache?
/harness-decide D-004 B, because it is simpler

inputs.name: action
inputs.description: Menu word: closed or all. Alone, the skill shows open decisions and offers to go through them; other text explains that decision, question, or statement and asks for the choice. Operation-specific approvals still apply.

inputs.name: filter
inputs.description: Decision status filter for the views. Open, shown when the skill runs alone, adds a brief optional-configuration summary; closed and all are the menu words, and all includes the detailed checklist. Closed and exact-ID views omit configuration; an exact ID is shown regardless of status.
